name: dtech-website
description: D-TECH Solution Integrators static website — build tooling (Tailwind and CSS/JS minify). nodemailer is the only runtime dependency (SMTP for the api/ functions).

scripts.build:js: for f in assets/lucide.js assets/agent-a.js assets/refined.js assets/events.js assets/gallery.js; do npx -y terser "$f" -c -m -o "${f%.js}.min.js"; done
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run stamp && npm run csp
scripts.verify: npm ci && npm run build && npm run check:links && npm run check:ui && npm run check:csp && node --check sw.js && node --check assets/agent-a.min.js && node --check assets/events.min.js && node --check assets/gallery.min.js && node --check assets/brand-marquee.js && echo VERIFY-OK
